input.free_text_description: This system is a user management platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including constant, response bean, user role, user. The platform provides capabilities for user realm, custom cache manager, i user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage constant records, so that I can track and organize constant data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage response bean records, so that I can track and organize response bean data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user role records, so that I can track and organize user role data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
